title: Highest-scoring trainer after teaching about 90 people Scrum
summary: My last Scrum workshop at Amazon scored 4.57 out of 5 and made me the program's highest-scoring trainer that month, after about 90 people across 3 Scrum workshops.
the_call: Keep building Scrum skills in other teams alongside my delivery work.
what_i_did: Taught about 90 people across 3 Scrum workshops, plus a product ownership workshop, as a volunteer trainer.
what_changed: Highest-scoring trainer in the monthly program update; a participant wrote that I made the group comfortable to engage and argue back.

quotes.text: I really liked the way Datta took our questions with all excitement and made us comfortable to freely engage in conversations and counter arguments.
Congratulations on being the highest scoring trainer!!
